test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The important points were narrated in the class by the teacher.

options.text: The teacher was narrating important points in the class.
The teacher had narrated the important points in the class.
The teacher narrated the important points in the class.
In the class, the important points were narrated.

solution:
The correct answer is **The teacher narrated the important points in the class.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

In order to convert a passive sentence into an active one-

__
 
• The **object** should be **brought back to its original object position** from the subject position.
 
• The be verb should be omitted.
 
• The tense will remain the same.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **The teacher narrated the important points in the class.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 **is **incorrect** as the sentence is in **past continuous **tense while the main sentence is in the past tense.
 
• **Option 2 **is **incorrect** as the sentence is in **past perfect **tense while the main sentence is in the past tense.
 
• **Option two** is **grammatically incorrect** as the past perfect tense is used only **when two works happened simultaneously inthe past tense;** the work that happened earlier is of past perfect tense while the **other is converted into past tense**.
 
• **Option 4** is in **passive voice.**
